description: This file defines a class 'HTTP_Request_Listener' which implements the observer pattern for handling events related to HTTP request and response objects. It includes methods for initialization, retrieving an identifier, and handling event notifications.

classes.name: HTTP_Request_Listener
classes.description: A class that implements an observer for HTTP request/response objects, capable of receiving event notifications.

methods.name: HTTP_Request_Listener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener with a unique ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the listener.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method called when the listener is notified of an event; outputs event details.
